_meta.description: Tag taxonomy for the dogma annotation validation helper. Edit this file to add, remove, or re-describe tags. The app reads it at startup. Each section has a 'selection' mode ('single' or 'multi'), a 'validated' flag (when false, any tag value is allowed and no error is flagged), and a 'tags' map of TAG -> human-readable description.

tags.URBAN: Cityscape with paved sidewalks, buildings, street signs, urban infrastructure (lamp posts, benches, storefronts)
tags.TRAIL: Unpaved natural path, dirt trail, hiking path with trail markers or worn paths through nature
tags.FOREST: Dense woodland area with trees as primary feature, natural ground cover (leaves, undergrowth)
tags.RURAL: Countryside setting with open fields, farmland, grassland, scattered or no buildings
tags.INDOOR: Interior of any building with artificial lighting (stores, offices, homes, malls)
tags.INTERSECTION: Street crossing area with at least one of: crosswalk markings, traffic lights, or clear intersection geometry
tags.PLAYGROUND: Recreational sports area including basketball courts, soccer fields, tennis courts, or similar athletic facilities
tags.NONE: Environment cannot be determined from available visual information

tags.WEATHER_RAIN: Rain falling or wet ground/surfaces indicating recent rain
tags.WEATHER_SNOW: Snow on ground or actively falling snow visible
tags.LIGHTING_LOW: Dim lighting conditions (dusk, dawn, heavy overcast, or poorly lit area)
tags.LIGHTING_BRIGHT: Strong sunlight or bright artificial lighting creating high contrast or glare
tags.INDOOR: Interior environment with artificial lighting (store, building, indoor space)
tags.TRAFFIC_ACTIVE: Active roadway with moving vehicles visible or audible traffic flow nearby

tags.WALKING: Handler and dog moving forward together at steady walking pace (not running)
tags.RUNNING: Handler and dog moving forward together at running or jogging pace
tags.STATIONARY: Both handler and dog are stationary with no forward movement for at least 1-2 seconds
tags.TURNING: Team is actively changing direction with visible left or right turn in progress
tags.HUMAN_DOG_INTERACTION: Direct physical interaction or feeding between handler and dog (petting, treating, reaching)
tags.SOCIAL_ENCOUNTER: Interaction with other people or dogs beyond the handler-dog team
tags.OBJECT_INTERACTION: Dog actively interacting with environmental object (water bowl, toy, item on ground)
tags.CROSSING_STREET: Team actively crossing street OR stopped at curb preparing to cross
tags.NAVIGATING_OBSTACLE: Team maneuvering around or past obstacles, barriers, or constrained spaces
tags.INDOOR_NAVIGATION: Team navigating indoor space (store aisles, building interior, hallways)
tags.ENVIRONMENTAL_MONITORING: Dog scanning environment with head turning, alert posture, or vigilant behavior
tags.DISTRACTION_EVENT: Dog reacting to external stimulus (vehicle, person, animal, loud sound)

tags.D_WALKING_FORWARD: Dog moving forward with steady, rhythmic gait (all four paws progressing forward)
tags.D_RUNNING: Dog moving at fast pace with extended stride and increased speed
tags.D_STOPPED: Dog is completely stationary with all four paws planted and no movement
tags.D_LYING_DOWN: Dog's body is flat on ground in resting position
tags.D_BODY_SHAKE: Dog shaking entire body from head to tail (often after getting wet or waking)
tags.D_TURNING_LEFT_BODY: Dog's entire body pivoting or rotating to the left (>=45 degree body rotation)
tags.D_TURNING_RIGHT_BODY: Dog's entire body pivoting or rotating to the right (>=45 degree body rotation)
tags.D_HEAD_LOOKING_LEFT: Dog's head rotated to the left while body continues facing forward (no body turn)
tags.D_HEAD_LOOKING_RIGHT: Dog's head rotated to the right while body continues facing forward (no body turn)
tags.D_SNIFFING_GROUND: Dog's nose pressed to or very close to ground surface in sniffing behavior
tags.D_SNIFFING_OBJECT: Dog's nose directed at and investigating a specific object (pole, wall, bag, fence, etc.)
tags.D_DRINKING: Dog actively drinking water from bowl, fountain, or water source (mouth at water, lapping visible)
tags.D_PLAY_JUMPING: Dog jumping up and down as part of play behavior (not jumping on person)
tags.D_PLAY_RUNNING: Dog running in playful non-linear or linear pattern (zoomies, circling, bouncing, erratic movement)
tags.D_PLAY_BOW: Dog in play solicitation posture with front end down and rear end up
tags.D_PLAY_ROLLING: Dog rolling onto back or side on ground in playful manner (exposing belly)
tags.PLAY_CHASE_WITH_DOG: Dog chasing or being chased by another dog in reciprocal play
tags.PLAY_CHEWING_TOY: Dog actively chewing on toy or object with repetitive jaw motion
tags.PLAY_FETCH_RUNNING: Dog running toward thrown object (ball, toy, stick) to retrieve it
tags.PLAY_FETCH_RETURNING: Dog carrying object in mouth while returning to handler
tags.D_PULLING_FORWARD: Dog actively straining forward against leash/harness resistance with forward body lean
tags.D_RESIST_BACKWARD: Dog bracing body backward or planting feet against handler's forward pull or direction
tags.D_LEASH_TAUT: Visible tension in leash or harness with straight line from handler to dog
tags.D_LEASH_SLACK: Leash hanging loosely with visible U-shape or droop, no tension
tags.H_PETTING_DOG: Handler touching dog with affectionate stroke or pat
tags.H_GIVING_TREAT: Handler offering food treat to dog (hand extended with treat or dog taking treat from hand)
tags.H_REACHING_FOR_DOG: Handler extending hand or arm toward dog's body or head
tags.H_GESTURING_COMMAND: Handler making hand signal, command gesture, or directive motion with hand/arm to dog
tags.H_POINTING: Handler extending arm with finger pointed at specific target or direction
tags.PERSON_PETTING_DOG: Someone other than handler is physically petting or touching the dog
tags.PERSON_FEEDING_DOG: Someone other than handler offering food or treat to dog
tags.DOG_SOCIAL_APPROACH: Dog moves toward a person in friendly manner
tags.DOG_GREETING: Dogs sniffing each other in greeting behavior (nose-to-nose or nose-to-body contact)
tags.DOG_PLAYING: Dogs engaged in mutual play behavior (play bows, chasing, wrestling)
tags.DOG_PASSING: Another dog passing by in close proximity without direct interaction
tags.PERSON_APPROACHING_CLOSE: Person walking toward team on path that will pass within 0-1 meters
tags.PERSON_APPROACHING_MEDIUM: Person walking toward team on path that will pass within 1-3 meters
tags.PERSON_APPROACHING_FAR: Person walking toward team at distance of 3+ meters
tags.PERSON_PASSING_CLOSE: Pedestrian passing within 0-1 meters of the team (immediate proximity)
tags.PERSON_PASSING_MEDIUM: Pedestrian passing within 1-3 meters of the team
tags.PERSON_STATIONARY_NEARBY: Person standing or stationary within 3 meters of team (not moving past)
tags.CROWD_PRESENT: Multiple people (4 or more) visible creating dense environment in scene
tags.VEHICLE_APPROACHING: Moving vehicle approaching dog's location or path
tags.VEHICLE_PASSING: Moving vehicle (car, bus, bicycle, motorcycle) passing nearby the team
tags.VEHICLE_WAITING: Team is stopped and waiting for vehicle to pass before proceeding
tags.VEHICLE_STOPPED_NEARBY: Parked or stationary vehicle visible in scene
tags.OBSTACLE_IN_PATH: Object blocking or partially blocking walking path ahead (pole, sign, barrier, construction)
tags.NARROW_PASSAGE_AHEAD: Constrained space requiring navigation is visible ahead (between poles, narrow doorway, between parked cars)
tags.DOOR_OPENING: Door being opened by handler or opening automatically

tags.NAV_CURB_AHEAD: Curb or edge where sidewalk meets street is visible in immediate path ahead
tags.NAV_AT_CURB: Team is positioned at curb edge (standing at the boundary between sidewalk and street)
tags.NAV_STEPPING_UP: Handler or dog stepping up onto elevated surface (curb, stairs, ramp going up)
tags.NAV_STEPPING_DOWN: Handler or dog stepping down from elevated surface (curb, stairs, ramp going down)
tags.NAV_STAIRS_AHEAD: Stairway (ascending or descending) visible in team's path or immediate vicinity
tags.NAV_OBSTACLE_PRESENT: Object requiring navigation around or past is in current location
tags.NAV_NARROW_SPACE: Team is currently in constrained passage requiring careful navigation
tags.NAV_OPEN_SPACE: Wide unobstructed area such as park, plaza, field, or large open sidewalk
tags.NAV_AT_CROSSWALK: Team positioned at the edge or start of a marked crosswalk
tags.NAV_CROSSWALK_MARKINGS: White painted zebra stripes or crosswalk lines visible on pavement
tags.NAV_TRAFFIC_SIGNAL: Traffic light or pedestrian signal visible in scene
tags.NAV_WAITING_TO_CROSS: Team stopped at intersection edge before crossing (not yet in roadway)
tags.NAV_CROSSING_ACTIVE: Team is currently in motion across the street or crosswalk
tags.NAV_CROSSED_STREET: Team has completed crossing and reached opposite side of street
tags.NAV_DOG_STOPS_AT_EDGE: Dog halts movement at curb edge, stairs, ramp, or elevation change
tags.NAV_DOG_STOPS_AT_OBSTACLE: Dog halts when path is blocked by object (pole, person, barrier, debris)
tags.NAV_DOG_ARC_AROUND: Dog creates curved path around obstacle rather than walking straight (smooth deviation visible)

tags.REACT_TO_PERSON_CLOSE: Dog orients head or body toward person within 2 meters showing awareness
tags.REACT_TO_PERSON_FAR: Dog orients head or body toward person beyond 2 meters showing awareness
tags.REACT_TO_DOG: Dog orients head or body toward another dog, showing awareness or interest
tags.REACT_TO_VEHICLE: Dog shows awareness of vehicle through head turn, body shift, or attention change
tags.REACT_TO_SOUND: Dog responds to audible stimulus with head turn, ear shift, body startle, or attention redirect
tags.ALERT_STANCE: Dog in attentive stance: body upright, ears forward or perked, focused gaze, tail up
tags.TRACKING_MOVEMENT: Dog's head continuously follows moving person, animal, or object (head tracks motion)

tags.H_WALKING_FORWARD: Handler moving forward with walking gait
tags.H_RUNNING: Handler moving at jogging or running pace
tags.H_STOPPED: Handler is stationary, not taking steps
tags.H_TURNING_LEFT: Handler's body turning to the left (changing direction)
tags.H_TURNING_RIGHT: Handler's body turning to the right (changing direction)
tags.H_BENDING_DOWN: Handler bending at waist toward dog or ground level
tags.H_PULLING_LEASH: Handler actively pulling on leash to guide or redirect dog (arm extended, visible tension)
tags.H_LOOSENING_LEASH: Handler releasing tension from leash (arm moving to create slack)
tags.H_HOLDING_LEASH_TAUT: Handler maintaining steady tension in leash without pulling motion
tags.H_LEASH_IN_HAND: Handler is clearly holding the leash in their hand (leash visible in grip)
tags.H_CARRYING_OBJECT: Handler holding or carrying item (bag, phone, shopping bag, cup, backpack, etc.)
tags.H_PHONE_IN_HAND: Handler holding mobile phone in hand (visible in grip)
tags.H_OPENING_DOOR: Handler actively pushing or pulling a door open
tags.H_TALKING_TO_PERSON: Handler engaged in conversation with another person (facing person, mouth moving, social engagement)
